content.comment_body: I'm experiencing the same problem. Using Microsoft Network Monitor, I observed that when attempting to download a program to [product_name], java.exe tries to communicate with a Weintek Pass-through application. Do you have the Weintek software installed as well? I haven't found a solution yet, but there appears to be interaction between these two applications. Disabling the wireless connection eliminates the lag issues.

Closed because the question was posted twice. The second thread titled 'When enabling network (wireless adapter) it is lagging' is published in the [product_name] - Communication section. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports slow and laggy connections when downloading programs to a [product_name] device, likely due to interactions between the [product_name] software and a Weintek Pass-Through application. Disabling wireless networking resolves the latency, suggesting a conflict in network resource usage between these applications.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects smooth and rapid programming and communication with the [product_name] device, even when other network-related software or adapters are running.
